title: exploreUntil + givePlacedItemBack primitives — live world
scenario: REAL merged primitives (unmodified) through live deps. Arc: crafting table placed (U2 harness with flake-retry), bot walks 18 blocks inland, exploreUntil legs back WEST with a table-in-sight predicate (found in one 16-block leg, elapsedMs 2778), then givePlacedItemBack walks to the cell, digs the table, sweeps for the drop.

evidence.onCamera: Table placed shoreline mid-frame; bot walks out east, exploreUntil legs return it west into frame; dig removes the table.
evidence.honestOutcome: recovered:false IS the primitive's spec'd honest path — the block was verified removed but the drop sweep missed the item entity ('honesty over optimism' from the port's design). Rehearsal-2's log (committed take notes) shows the recovered:true path green as well: same chain, drop swept, inventory gained the table.
evidence.noCheatProperty: givePlacedItemBack is the no-cheat rewrite — Voyager's original used /give resets; this dig-and-collect version runs on vanilla mechanics only (the in-suite grep property test pins it).

caveats: Five takes: one sabotaged by a zombie process stopping OBS mid-recording (fixed — take orchestration is now single-process), one PLACE_FAILED flake (retry added to harness), one close-range GoalLookAtBlock wedge (PATH_NOT_FOUND, honest). World-set clutter from repeated takes cleaned via setblock.

Drop-sweep reliability is an adapter concern (item entity spawn latency + pickup radius), not a primitive defect — assembly should reuse the executor's gather-drop collection instead of the drill's simple sweep.
